dimensions.assessment: Affects importers of covered articles from Haiti and the Haitian apparel manufacturing sector.
dimensions.evidence: special duty-free rules for various apparel products imported from Haiti

dimensions.assessment: Provides financial relief through duty-free treatment and refunds of duties previously paid on recent entries.
dimensions.evidence: CBP must refund any duties previously paid with respect to the entry within 90 days.

dimensions.assessment: Results in federal revenue reductions from waived tariffs and requires refunds of collected duties without interest.
dimensions.evidence: Any amounts owed by the United States pursuant to the liquidation or reliquidation of an entry... shall be paid, without interest

dimensions.assessment: Extends an existing trade preference program and directs administrative tariff schedule modifications.
dimensions.evidence: The President shall proclaim such modifications to the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States

dimensions.assessment: Extends preferential treatment rules temporarily through December 31, 2028.
dimensions.evidence: The duty-free treatment provided under this section shall remain in effect until December 31, 2028.

missing_information: The exact monetary total of retroactive duty refunds to be paid by the federal government.
importance_detail.rationale: Extends duty-free and preferential tariff rules for apparel imports from Haiti through December 2028 and provides for retroactive duty refunds.

card.summary: H.R. 7148, titled the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, became Public Law No. 119-75 on February 3, 2026. This federal law provides funding for the Department of Defense, Departments of Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education, as well as Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and related agencies for fiscal year 2026. It also sets guidelines for the U.S. Sentencing Commission, extends various healthcare, Medicaid, Medicare, and trade programs, introduces pharmacy benefit management transparency rules, and awards a payment to the widow of a late representative.
